messages:
Alex M: Heads-up — starting prod deploy in 10m. Plan: enable feature flag feature_x via a micro-surge valve ramp: 0 → 1% (smoke) → 5% → 20% → 100% over ~35m. Auto-hold if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p95 latency > +30% relative. Pin model routing to v2.3.1 on dedicated pool during canary. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-21-feature-x

Alex M: Quick commands for the ramp and emergency disable:
```
# ramp to 1%
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"feature_x","percent":1}' https://flags.redwood/api/toggle

# immediate disable
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"feature_x","percent":0}' https://flags.redwood/api/toggle
```

deploy-bot: deploy-job/7123 queued by Alex M — ETA ~10m :rocket:

Priya S: confirm the circuit-breaker alarm targets and pin TTL? do we want auto-rollback or manual? :thinking_face:

Alex M: CB targets above. We'll keep auto-hold only (not auto-rollback). Manual rollback required to avoid noisy flips. Pin TTL 30m for the model route; extend manually if smoke is clean.

Kevin (oncall): Keep first two slices (1% and 5%) on for at least 5m each. I'll watch SLOs. If p95 jumps >25% for 3m, call rollback.

Jamie (prod): add a short note in rn about limited cohort exposure and customers on embargo list — we should exclude enterprise customers in the 1% cohort.

Priya S: can we enable cohort exclusion? feature flag supports negative cohorts. I'll add exclude:enterprise to the 1% slice.

Alex M: done. tailoring cohort for 1% slice.

deploy-bot: deploy-job/7123 started on prod cluster-a.

deploy-bot: ramp: feature_x -> 1% succeeded (check: smoke ok). :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: ramp: feature_x -> 5% succeeded. monitor for next 10m.

Kevin (oncall): seeing a slight spike in p95 on pod-gamma at +18% — within threshold.

Alex M: continue to 20% in 10m if stable.

deploy-bot: ramping: feature_x -> 20% (initiated)

deploy-bot: ALERT: Auto-hold triggered for feature_x — 5xx rate crossed 0.5% on region eu-west for 2m. Ramp paused.

Priya S: I'm seeing the same. error rate concentrated to calls hitting model v2.3.1 on pool-dedicated. Suggest immediate fast-disable to avoid user impact.

Alex M: executing immediate disable command now.

Alex M: ```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"feature_x","percent":0}' https://flags.redwood/api/toggle
```

deploy-bot: ramp: feature_x -> 0% succeeded. Flag disabled.

deploy-bot: deploy-job/7123 note: canary paused and rolled back to pre-deploy routing. model pin removed.

Kevin (oncall): traffic back to baseline. collecting logs and traces for a 30m post-mortem.

Alex M: good catch. We'll revert v2.3.1 routing recommendation and open an incident for infra/repro. PR with rollback steps + annotated telemetry in the release notes.

Jamie (prod): copying brief RN entry: "Deployed feature_x ramp; auto-hold triggered at 20% due to model 5xx on v2.3.1 — feature disabled and routing pinned rolled back. Investigation ongoing." Put on page.

Priya S: recommend we add a short gating test for v2.3.1 in staging that simulates long-tail inputs before reattempt.

Alex M: agreed. we'll target a re-deploy tomorrow after repro and a staging soak. Thanks all.

Kevin (oncall): leaving additional watch for 30m. If anything else, call in channel.

Jamie (prod): +1, will update release notes and notify comms channel.
